PAINTING & BODYWORK · Painting

Full Vehicle Repainting in Riyadh

Complete vehicle repainting at QSC's Riyadh painting facility — for sun-damaged, color-changed or comprehensively restored luxury cars, with honest scoping first.

  1. Home
  2. Painting & Bodywork
  3. Full Vehicle Repainting

A full repaint is the most demanding job a paint shop takes on: every panel, every edge, every jamb decision affects whether the result looks factory or 'resprayed'. It is the right choice when sun damage is widespread, when a color change is wanted, or when restoration justifies it — and the wrong choice when a targeted repair would serve better. QSC scopes a full repaint honestly: what gets disassembled, how jambs and edges are handled, and what the realistic outcome is for the car's condition and budget.

Frequently asked questions

Does a full repaint lower my car's value?

A documented, high-quality repaint on a car whose paint had genuinely failed usually helps, not hurts. What damages value is undisclosed or poor-quality paintwork — which is exactly what proper scoping and documentation avoid.

Can I change the color completely?

Yes — a color change is scoped with jambs, engine bay and boot surfaces discussed explicitly, since how far the new color extends is the main cost and quality decision. Regulatory notification requirements for color changes are yours to complete; the workshop will remind you.

Full repaint or panel repairs — how do I choose?

Send photos of the car for an initial view, then bring it in. The honest answer depends on how many panels are affected and the condition beneath; sometimes the cheaper targeted path is genuinely the better one, and the assessment will say so.
